false_positives.comment: Reviewed against PR #222 head cf95ea8d7d2f2f3cb73c22322cee8b02d086a74b using repository search and complete relevant project source. EncodingPicker::Notify iterates wxTopLevelWindows and converts window to dialog with wxDynamicCast. That macro returns the same object address after removing const qualification and checking its dynamic type. Notify selects the dialog's tree item, then sends a wxEVT_BUTTON OK/Cancel event through dialog->GetEventHandler()->ProcessEvent(response). wxWindow::GetEventHandler() is const but returns the mutable handler for this same window. wxDialogBase's event table dispatches the event to OnButton, which calls AcceptAndClose/EndDialog and EndModal for this modal dialog. The pointee behind window is therefore modified through the cast and handler aliases. The S5350 read-only-object premise is false. Framework source: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/object.h ; https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/window.h ; https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/src/common/dlgcmn.cpp

EncodingPicker::Notify deliberately changes the modal dialog: after selecting a tree item it calls dialog->GetEventHandler()->ProcessEvent(response) with wxEVT_BUTTON and wxID_OK or wxID_CANCEL. wxWindow::GetEventHandler() is const-qualified but returns the mutable event handler for that same window. The pinned wxDialogBase event table routes this event through OnButton to AcceptAndClose/EndDialog, which calls EndModal for this modal dialog.
